name: Forced displacement
summary: No new mass displacement event this month; global total above 120 million
state: UNHCR puts global forced displacement above 122 million. No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month was found as of 1 Nov, though Cyclone Murasu's landfall in Andhra Pradesh on 3 Nov may prompt large precautionary evacuations, and UNHCR warns displacement in Ukraine is worsening.
for_you: Displacement pressures are high but not newly spiking.
